
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20048498" title="发布于 2026-05-15 10:04">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15. 别再硬写提示词了！LangChain ChatPromptTemplate核心实战</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
在使用LangChain与AI交互时，想要让对话更有条理、适配多角色、多轮次的沟通场景，ChatPromptTemplate这个工具绝对少不了。它本质上就是一个用来构建聊天消息列表的提示模板，能帮我们规范AI的交互逻辑，让每一次对话都更贴合预期。
<p>如果你喜欢看视频学习，就看&nbsp;<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_wrapper_link-info cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="link-info cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="《15. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate核心实战》" href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1oq5y6dE3k/" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bilibili.com%2Fvideo%2FBV1oq5y6dE3k%2F%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22%E3%80%8A15.%20LangChain%20ChatPromptTemplate%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E5%AE%9E%E6%88%98%E3%80%8B%22%2C%22desc%22%3A%22%22%2C%22icon%22%3A%22%22%2C%22isCard%22%3Afalse%2C%22hasResquest%22%3Atrue%2C%22iconDefault%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.6%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DQ239%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22YZCXmh-1778810255124%22%2C%22classes%22%3A%7B%22link-info%22%3A1%7D%7D" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.6/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=Q239" data-link-title="《15. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate核心实战》" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">《15. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate核心实战》</a>。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>prompt_template =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    SystemMessagePromptTemplate.from_template(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是AI开发助手{name}，擅长编程开发。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    HumanMessagePromptTemplate.from_template(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你能帮我做什么？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    AIMessagePromptTemplate.from_template(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">我可以帮你写代码、改bug。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    HumanMessagePromptTemplate.from_template(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{user_question}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
])</span></pre>
</div>
<p>使用这个模板时，写法可以灵活调整。如果只是简单传递消息内容，不需要额外附带参数，用字符串别名的写法会特别简洁，省去不少冗余操作。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>prompt_template =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是AI开发助手{name}，擅长编程。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你能帮我做什么？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">我可以帮你写代码、改bug。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{user_question}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
])</span></pre>
</div>
<p>但如果追求更高的清晰性和可扩展性，想兼容一些高级功能，那字典写法就比元组简写更合适，后续维护和修改也会更方便。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>prompt_template =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是AI开发助手{name}，擅长编程。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你能帮我做什么？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">我可以帮你写代码、改bug。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{user_question}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
])</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这里要重点说一下不同字符串别名的用法，它们对应着不同的消息类，各有明确的用途和使用规则，记清楚这些能避免很多操作失误。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<table style="width: 886px; height: 282px" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="90">
<p align="center">字符串别名</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="125">
<p align="center">对应消息类</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="219">
<p align="center">用途</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="170">
<p align="center">使用规则</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="90">
<p>system</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="125">
<p>SystemMessage</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="219">
<p>给AI设定人设、规则和上下文</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="170">
<p>必在开头只能有1个</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="90">
<p>user/human</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="125">
<p>HumanMessage</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="219">
<p>代表用户的输入</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="170">
<p>与“ai”交替，不能连续出现2个</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="90">
<p>ai/assistant</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="125">
<p>AIMessage</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="219">
<p>表示AI的输出约束</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="170">
<p>跟在“user”后，不能连续出现2个</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>了解完这些基础规则，就到了实战环节，其实操作步骤很简单，一步步来就能上手。首先要做的就是导入ChatPromptTemplate类，这是所有后续操作的基础。接着，用from_messages方法创建这个类的实例，这个方法需要接收一个消息列表作为参数，列表里的每条消息都是包含role和content字段的字典，其中content里用大括号包裹的部分，就是我们后续要填充的变量占位符。通过system、user、ai这三种角色的搭配，我们就能轻松定义出完整的对话上下文，甚至可以加入回答范例，让AI更清楚该如何响应。</p>
<p>创建好实例后，调用invoke方法，传入一个包含具体填充值的字典，它就会自动替换掉所有的占位符，生成一个完整的PromptValue提示词对象。最后，把这个PromptValue对象传入已经初始化好的大语言模型的invoke方法，就能完成一次规范的AI交互了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate

prompt_template </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是AI开发助手{name}，擅长编程开发和技术问题解答。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你能帮我做什么？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">我可以帮你写代码、改bug、设计技术方案。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{user_question}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
])
prompt_value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt_template.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">神算子</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user_question</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用Python写一个简单的计算器程序</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)
res </span>= llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(res.content)</pre>
</div>
<p>除此之外，还有一个实用小技巧可以记一下。如果我们需要预先定义部分变量，不用每次都完整传入所有参数，借助partial方法就能轻松指定，后续使用时只需要补充剩余变量即可。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate

prompt_template </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是AI开发助手{name}，擅长编程开发和技术问题解答。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你能帮我做什么？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">我可以帮你写代码、改bug、设计技术方案。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{user_question}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
])
partial_prompt </span>= prompt_template.partial(name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">神算子</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
prompt_value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> partial_prompt.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user_question</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用Python写一个简单的计算器程序</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)
res </span>= llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(res.content)</pre>
</div>
<p>要是想在模板中嵌入消息列表，比如多轮对话的历史消息，就可以使用MessagesPlaceholder，它的字符串别名是placeholder，用起来特别便捷，能很好地适配多轮交互场景。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate

prompt_template </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是AI开发助手{name}，擅长编程开发和技术问题解答。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
